text:
maria: FYI KMS audit logs spiked at 09:12. Found an unexpected admin grant tied to legacy-project-x (cross-account key). Looks like a service-account was granted roles/owner on a bucket and also bound to kms:CryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for project-prod. :grimacing:
chris: Can you paste the log ID or a snippet?
maria: log id: projects/redwood-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity id=abc123
maria: quick query I ran:
```
SELECT protopayload_auditlog.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, protoPayload.methodName, resourceName
FROM `redwood-prod.audit_logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity_*`
WHERE protoPayload.methodName LIKE '%SetIamPolicy%' AND timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50;
```
jordan: :eyes: That principal shouldn't have owner. Is this tied to the infra migration last month?
alice: I think that SA was created during the legacy backup job. We disabled the job but didn't rotate bindings.
maria: Proposed clean-up plan:
1) Run `rbac-scan --scope=project:legacy-project-x --dry-run` to list effected principals
2) Lockdown KMS key with `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding` into a temp policy
3) Canary prune 5 low-risk SA bindings next Tue 09:00 PST (jordan to lead)
4) If canary passes, schedule bulk prune and owner backfills
chris: Add a pre-check: run evals on any scheduled cron that references that SA, and snapshot key usage stats for last 30 days.
ops-oncall: I'll add an alert rule for repeated SetIamPolicy on that key and make it severity P2.
jordan: I'll take canary. Need @alice for plan + a short runbook for rollback. I'll document expected metrics: auth failures <0.1%, latency stable.
alice: I'll review and add KMS key policy snippet and approve rollback steps.
maria: Also, we should add evidence to the access-review board: include the query, canary PR link, and list of affected services.
dev-bot: rotation-bot scheduled rotation for key projects/prod/key1 at 2024-11-12T03:00Z
chris: timeline looks good. any blockers?
maria: only blocker is confirmation of no scheduled jobs from payments-team. @payments-lead can you confirm by EOD?
payments-lead: we have no jobs referencing that SA, safe to proceed :thumbsup:
maria: OK. Jordan + Alice, please run the canary Tue 09:00 PST. Ping here when done. Thanks :pray:
